facts.headline: The Solar Coal Crossover Shows the Grid Moving Faster Than Its Politics
facts.summary: The solar coal crossover arrived in May, when solar produced more U.S. electricity than coal for the first time on record. It is not victory. It is a fracture: the grid is moving into a different energy regime while federal politics keeps trying to preserve the one that is ending.
